left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Ulcerative colitis  [AND] with confirmed diagnosis by histology  [OR] and endoscopy AND in stable remission for 3 months or more without  [OR] therapy or with a maintenance therapy (except steroids  [OR] and antibiotics for 3 months)
  -  A negative pregnancy test
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  No history or diagnosis of any of the following conditions: Chron's disease, [OR]  bleeding disorders, gastrointestinal  [OR] or colonic malignancy, [OR]  Kidney disease, including kidney "stones"  [OR] or hypercalcemia, [OR]  Coagulopathy/ [OR] hereditary hemorrhagic disorders/ [OR]  or receiving therapeutic doses of Coumadin  [OR] or heparin

right.raw_text: -  Ingested certain medications (Calcium, [OR]  Vitamin D, [OR]  fiber supplements  [OR] and Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs - NSAIDs) within 30 days of study start
